_comment: Per-model prompt templates. Placeholders: {q} query text, {task} per-family task text from `tasks`, {filename} chunk path, {code} chunk text. A null template means NO prefix (raw text). `verified` is true only if the template was checked against the model card; never invent a prompt - an unverifiable one is marked verified=false with a note. Verification status below reflects what was available when this file was committed (no network, cards not fetched).

tasks.nl_to_code: Given a natural language description, retrieve the code that implements it
tasks.issue_to_source: Given a bug report or stack trace, retrieve the source code that needs to change
